jobs.description:
Job DescriptionBuild our warehouse and logistics operations with us!

CS-International is a fast-growing international company operating in the trading card game, collectibles, gaming and entertainment industries.As our business continues to grow, we are building and professionalizing our warehouse and logistics operations in Ratingen. We are therefore looking for a hands-on Junior Warehouse & Logistics Manager who wants to take real ownership, develop scalable processes and grow into a future leadership position.This is not a purely administrative role. You will work directly within the operation, help establish our systems and processes from scratch and gradually take over responsibility for the entire warehouse and logistics function.

Your responsibilities
• Support the setup and continuous development of our warehouse and logistics operations in our brand new warehouse in Ratingen
• Help design efficient processes for inbound goods, storage, picking, packing, shipping and returns
• Actively participate in day-to-day warehouse operations, particularly during the setup phase and peak periods
• Support the implementation and configuration of our new ERP and warehouse management processes
• Translate operational requirements into practical ERP workflows together with management, internal teams and external implementation partners
• Establish clear processes for inventory management, stock accuracy, cycle counts and annual stocktaking
• Help define warehouse layouts, storage locations, product flows and picking structures
• Coordinate parcel and freight shipments as well as relationships with carriers and logistics service providers
• Monitor operational performance and develop relevant KPIs and reports
• Identify bottlenecks, errors and inefficient processes and implement practical improvements
• Create and maintain process documentation, work instructions and operational standards
• Gradually coordinate and lead warehouse employees and temporary staff
• Support logistics planning for events, conventions, retail activities and international projects
• Work closely with Events/Organized Play, Project Management and Management
• Take on increasing responsibility with the long-term perspective of leading our warehouse and logistics department
• Grow gradually into this role, having the opportunity to become part of our management

Qualifications
• Completed vocational training or a degree in logistics, supply chain management, business administration or a comparable field
• Approximately two to three years of relevant professional experience in warehousing, logistics, fulfilment or supply chain operations
• Practical understanding of inbound goods, storage, inventory management, picking, packing, shipping and returns
• Confident use of Microsoft Office applications and general familiarity with digital business systems
• Very good written and spoken German and good written and spoken English (Our main language is ENGLISH!)

Experience with ERP or warehouse management systems, Microsoft Dynamics 365 Business Central, Shopify, shipping software, international logistics or the coordination of operational teams would be an advantage, but is not essential.

Your Profile
• You have a hands-on mentality and are willing to actively support day-to-day warehouse operations
• You enjoy building new processes, systems and structures rather than simply maintaining established routines
• You work in a structured, accurate and independent manner and take ownership of your responsibilities
• You are able to identify operational problems and develop practical, workable solutions
• You communicate reliably and enjoy working across departments and with external service providers
• You are motivated to support the implementation of a new ERP and warehouse management structure, you are a stakeholder in this process
• You are comfortable working in a growing environment where processes are still being developed
• You have the ambition to gradually take on leadership responsibility and develop into the future head of our warehouse and logistics operations

You do not need to already have experience in every individual area. What matters most to us is your understanding of warehouse operations, your willingness to actively build new structures and your motivation to grow into a responsible leadership position. We want to help you developing with workshops etc. in areas you are not 100% confident.
What to expect
• A key role in building and professionalising our warehouse and logistics operations from the ground up
• The opportunity to actively shape workflows, warehouse structures and operational standards
• Direct involvement in the implementation of our new ERP and warehouse management processes
• A varied position combining hands-on warehouse operations, process development and project work
• A high level of ownership and the freedom to contribute and implement your own ideas
• Close cooperation with management and the opportunity to get involved into the gaming industry
• Short decision-making paths and an international working environment
• Diverse products and projects from the trading card game, collectibles, gaming and entertainment industries
• A growing operation in which responsibilities and leadership opportunities will increase over time
• A clear long-term development perspective towards leading our warehouse and logistics department

You will join us during an important development phase. Not every process is already finalised, and this is exactly where you will make a difference: By helping us create scalable structures that can support the company’s future growth.

About usCS-International GmbH is a fast-growing execution partner operating at the intersection of trading card games, events, retail activation, brands, logistics, organized play, community growth and product development.

We work with partners like Bandai, Wizards of the Coast, Konami, Toei Anima

jobs.occupation: Project Coordinator AGV and AMR (all gender) (Betriebswirt/in (Fachschule) - Projektmanagement)
jobs.description:
Your responsibilitiesAs Automation Project Coordinator, you create the control that allows technical teams to deliver. You work in a stable pairing with a Project Engineer from discovery to acceptance. The engineer owns the technical evidence and on-site solution. You own the project baseline, the communication, the decisions, the changes and the documented path to handover.
You will normally coordinate several AGV and AMR projects at the same time. That makes this a role for someone who can keep customers, engineers, the factory in China, dealers and internal functions aligned without losing detail or momentum.

What you will own
• Set up and manage projects with clear scope, milestones, responsibilities, dependencies, risks and acceptance criteria.
• Coordinate the end-to-end project delivery from site survey and feasibility through order preparation, implementation, testing, acceptance and handover.
• Maintain transparent project documentation and status, including plans, decisions, actions, risks, changes and approvals.
• Lead customer communication and cross-functional coordination with Engineering, Sales, factory teams, Logistics, After Sales, partners and other stakeholders.
• Manage scope changes, risks and project readiness, ensuring impacts are understood, approvals are secured and issues are escalated early.
• Coordinate testing, acceptance and handover to After Sales, and drive structured recovery plans when projects deviate from scope, timing or readiness.

How you work with the Project Engineer
• You and the Project Engineer stay paired from the first customer discovery through acceptance. You manage the system of work; the engineer owns technical truth.
• You do not approve technical feasibility without engineering evidence, and the engineer does not make unapproved commitments on scope, timing or commercial changes. Both roles use four-eyes reviews for important assumptions, documents and handovers.
• Our planning model is approximately one coordinator for three engineers. Engineers may spend several weeks at one customer site; you keep multiple projects controlled and give them a reliable route for decisions and escalation.

Your profile
• Experience coordinating or managing customer projects in industrial automation, intralogistics, robotics, material handling, systems integration or a comparable technical environment.
• Strong project management and organisational skills, including planning, risk and change management, documentation and follow-up.
• Sufficient technical understanding to identify gaps, ask the right questions and coordinate effectively with engineers and technical specialists.
• Clear and confident customer communication, professional English and a structured, ownership-driven working style. German or other European languages are an advantage.
• A relevant degree, vocational qualification or equivalent practical experience, combined with willingness to travel across Europe for key project phases.

Why us?EP gives project teams direct access to the people who make decisions: European leadership, the factory in China, technical specialists, dealers and customers. You will work in an international team at our Cologne-Mülheim headquarters and across live customer operations in Europe.
The delivery organisation is growing. You can help build the practical project standards that the team will use as we progress from more repeatable X-Pace implementations to increasingly complex Intelligent Product solutions.

Get in contact with EPSend your CV to recruiting@ep-equipment.eu and tell us when you could join. A traditional cover letter is not required; a short note explaining why this role fits your experience is enough.

About usAt EP Equipment, we don’t just manufacture electric pallet trucks and forklifts—we’re revolutionizing the industry! Our startup spirit, combined with our global strength, allows us to deliver exceptional solutions to customers worldwide through a powerful network of partners. Innovation isn’t just a goal—it’s part of our daily operations. Agile working isn’t a buzzword here; it’s embedded in our DNA.

jobs.employer_name: Infineon Technologies Dresden AG & Co. KG
jobs.description:
As a Principal Expert Factory Physics & Fab Performance (f/m/div), you will play a key role in shaping the performance of one of Europe's most advanced semiconductor manufacturing sites. By transforming manufacturing data into actionable insights, you will influence critical decisions on productivity, cycle time and capacity development. Your expertise will directly support the ramp-up of Infineon's €5 billion Smart Power Fab while helping to shape the future of Industrial Engineering in Dresden.

Your Role

Key responsibilities in your new role

- Serve as the Factory Physics authority for the Dresden site, developing models that translate manufacturing complexity into actionable insights for throughput, cycle time, variability and bottleneck management- Lead high-impact productivity programs, from identifying optimization potential to driving implementation and sustainable business results- Provide expert guidance on complex Industrial Engineering challenges and act as a trusted advisor to stakeholders across Operations, Planning, Technology, Equipment Engineering and Finance- Define and continuously enhance local performance benchmarks, assessment methods and analytical approaches to support data-driven decision-making- Strengthen the Industrial Engineering network through active collaboration and best-practice exchange with colleagues across Infineon's Front-End manufacturing sites

Your Profile
As Principal Expert Factory Physics & Fab Performance (f/m/div), you own the Factory Physics competence for the Dresden site. You model the fab as a physical system, identify the real bottlenecks and bring recommendations to decision — not to filing. Your work is directly visible: in the ramp decisions of the Smart Power Fab and in the strategic roadmap of the IE cluster. You build where others optimize and shape how Industrial Engineering in Dresden will make impact over the coming years.
Qualifications and skills to help you succeed

- Master's or Diploma degree in Industrial Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Physics, Operations Research or a comparable field; PhD is a plus- 6–10 years of relevant experience in Industrial Engineering, Manufacturing Science or Operations Research — with demonstrable Factory Physics application in a technology-intensive high-volume manufacturing environment- Strong expertise in Factory Physics methods, including throughput, variability, bottleneck and cycle-time analysis- Proficiency in SQL, Python or R and common BI tools for data-driven decision-making- Experience leading cross-functional program teams with 7–8-digit business impact and confidently engaging stakeholders up to senior management- Hands-on experience with fab analytics and simulation tools such as Smart OEE, AutoSched, D-Simcon or AnyLogic (nice to have)- Fluent German and English language skills, both written and spoken (B2-Niveau)

Nicole Hippmann, LinkedIn (https://www.linkedin.com/in/nicole-hippmann-01b036172/)

jobs.employer_name: Siemens Energy Global GmbH & Co. KG
jobs.description:
A Snapshot of Your Day 

Join us as an R&D Technology Project Manager (f/m/d) and immerse yourself in the exciting world of large gas turbines! You will lead innovative research and development projects, combining your technical expertise with professional project management skills. Imagine driving initiatives from the initial concept through to software development, validation, and industrial implementation. You will focus on developing cutting-edge software tools and computational methods in aerodynamics, heat transfer, mechanics, and materials science, while coordinating interdisciplinary teams and collaborating with universities and research institutions.

How You’ll Make an Impact 

* Leadership of complex R&D projects from concept and planning through technical implementation to industrial application
* Management of projects focused on scientific and engineering software tool development
* Coordination of methodology development in aerodynamics, heat transfer, mechanics, and materials science
* Project planning and oversight of schedules, budgets, resources, quality, risks, and deliverables
* Leadership of interdisciplinary international project teams and establishment of long-term research partnerships
* Identification of public funding opportunities, support of proposal preparation, project execution, reporting, and stakeholder communication

What You Bring

* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in an engineering or scientific discipline such as Mechanical Engineering, Energy Engineering, Aerospace Engineering, Physics, or Computer Science
* Several years of experience in research and development and managing technically demanding projects, preferably in the energy, turbomachinery, or gas turbine industry
* Understanding of aerodynamics, heat transfer, mechanics, materials science, or scientific software development
* Solid knowledge of project management methodologies, including risk, resource, schedule, and budget management
* Strategic and analytical thinking, leadership capability, and effective communication of complex technical topics to international and interdisciplinary teams
* Fluent in German and English, both written and spoken

About the Team

Our Gas Services division offers Low-emission power generation through service and decarbonization. Zero or low emission power generation and all gas turbines under one roof, steam turbines and generators. Decarbonization opportunities through service offerings, modernization, and digitalization of the fleet. 

Who is Siemens Energy? 

At Siemens Energy, we are more than just an energy technology company. With ~100.000 dedicated employees in more than 90 countries, we develop the energy systems of the future, ensuring that the growing energy demand of the global community is met reliably and sustainably. The technologies created in our research departments and factories drive the energy transition and provide the base for one sixth of the world's electricity generation.

Our global team is committed to making sustainable, reliable, and affordable energy a reality by pushing the boundaries of what is possible. We uphold a 150-year legacy of innovation that encourages our search for people who will support our focus on decarbonization, new technologies, and energy transformation.      

Find out how you can make a difference at Siemens Energy: https://www.siemens-energy.com/employeevideo

Our Commitment to Diversity 

Lucky for us, we are not all the same. Through diversity we generate power. We run on inclusion and our combined creative energy is fueled by over 130 nationalities. Siemens Energy celebrates character – no matter what ethnic background, gender, age, religion, identity, or disability. We energize society, all of society, and we do not discriminate based on our differences. 

Rewards/Benefits 

* In addition to an attractive remuneration package in line with the market, you can expect an attractive employer-financed company pension scheme
* We also offer the opportunity to become a Siemens Energy shareholder
* We offer our employees the opportunity to work flexibly and remotely, and our inspiring offices provide space for collaboration and creativity
* The professional and personal development of our employees is very important to us. We provide them with the opportunities to learn and develop in a self-determined way, various attractive programmes and learning materials are available for this purpose
* In relation to the "compatibility of family and work", we have a wide range of offers, e.g. flexible working time models, childcare places at many locations, the possibility of trial part-time work or even a sabbatical  

We value equal opportunities and welcome applications from people with disabilities.

https://jobs.siemens-energy.com/jobs

jobs.description:
DEKRA Arbeit GmbH, as part of DEKRA SE, is one of the top 10 personnel
service providers in Germany and one of the fastest-growing staffing
service providers in Europe.

With more than 120 locations across Germany and Europe, we are
committed to establishing flexible staffing solutions and making a
positive contribution to the regional labor market.

Help us continue to expand this successful business model and apply
today!

As one of the most successful and innovative personnel service
providers in Germany, we are currently looking for a Lead Technical
Facility Services (m/f/d) on behalf of our renowned client in Dresden,
starting as soon as possible, as part of a direct placement.

 

As a Lead Technical Facility Services (m/f/d), you will play a key
technical role in supporting international customers. You will be
responsible for installing, commissioning, qualifying and optimizing
advanced technical systems and providing hands-on technical support at
customer sites.

Working closely with engineering teams, you will use your technical
expertise to ensure excellent system performance and contribute to the
continuous improvement and development of products.

The position involves extensive travel throughout Europe, as well as a
willingness to participate in product training programs in the United
States.

 

Your responsibilities

jobs.occupation: PhD Position in Theoretical Condensed Matter Physics (three years) (m/f/x) (Physiker/in)
jobs.description:
In order to fill a fixed-term position in part-time (29.8725 hours/week = 75%;) by 12-2026, we are looking for one

PhD Position in Theoretical Condensed Matter Physics (three years) (m/f/x)

The Research Group of Prof. Ilya M. Eremin at Theoretical Physics III at Ruhr University Bochum conducts research on the theory of quantum materials, with a particular focus on strongly correlated electron systems, unconventional superconductivity, magnetism, and collective phenomena. Our research aims at developing a microscopic understanding of emergent electronic phases in quantum materials and their experimentally observable signatures. A central focus of our current research is the physics of unconventional superconductors and correlated quantum materials, including recently discovered nickelate superconductors. These systems provide a particularly rich platform in which electronic correlations, orbital degrees of freedom, magnetism, structural effects, and superconductivity are intimately intertwined. Understanding their phase diagrams and excitation spectra requires the development and application of advanced many-body theoretical approaches.

One PhD position in Theoretical Condensed Matter Physics is available in the Research Group Theoretical Physics III at Ruhr University Bochum. The successful candidate will investigate microscopic mechanisms of unconventional superconductivity and competing electronic phases in strongly correlated quantum materials. Particular emphasis will be placed on multiorbital systems such as bilayer and multilayer nickelates, although related problems in cuprates and other unconventional superconductors may also be addressed. The project will combine analytical and numerical many-body techniques, including tight-binding and multiorbital models, Green's-function methods, mean-field and Bogoliubov–de Gennes approaches, and methods for treating electronic correlations and collective excitations. Depending on the specific research direction and the candidate's interests, functional renormalization group, slave-boson/Gutzwiller approaches, random-phase approximation, and numerical calculations of experimentally measurable response functions may also be employed. An important aspect of the project will be the close connection between microscopic theory and current experiments, including spectroscopy, transport, and scattering measurements. The PhD researcher will work in an active international research environment and interact closely with theoretical and experimental collaborators in Germany and abroad.

Scope: part-time
Duration: fixed-term, 3 Jahre
Start: by 12-2026
Apply by:  2026-10-05

Your tasks:

- Development and investigation of microscopic theoretical models for strongly correlated quantum materials and unconventional superconductors.
- Study of superconductivity, magnetism, density-wave states, and competing or intertwined electronic orders in multiorbital systems.
- Analytical and numerical calculation of electronic structures, superconducting gap functions, collective excitations, and experimentally accessible response functions.
- Development and application of advanced many-body methods, depending on the specific research problem.
- Comparison of theoretical predictions with experimental results from spectroscopy, transport, and scattering experiments.
- Development, implementation, and documentation of numerical codes for theoretical calculations.
- Close collaboration with other members of the research group and with national and international theoretical and experimental partners.
- Presentation of research results at national and international conferences, workshops, and scientific meetings.
- Publication of the results in international peer-reviewed scientific journals.

Your profile:

- A successfully completed university degree (Master's degree or equivalent) in physics, with a strong background in theoretical physics.
- Very good knowledge of quantum mechanics and solid-state physics.
- A strong interest in condensed matter theory, quantum many-body physics, and unconventional superconductivity.
- Previous knowledge of many-body theory, superconductivity, magnetism, strongly correlated systems, or quantum field theoretical methods is advantageous.
- Experience with numerical calculations and scientific programming, for example in Python, C/C++, Julia, Mathematica, or comparable environments, is desirable.
- Candidates should be motivated to develop and apply analytical as well as numerical theoretical methods.
- Ability to work independently and reliably while contributing actively to collaborative research projects.
- Good communication skills and willingness to work in an international and interdisciplinary research environment.
- Good command of written and spoken English is expected.

- Besides, you ensure efficient and timely development of key HEOR deliverables (i.e. payer value stories, payer engagement tools, GVDs, economic models, retrospective database analyses, indirect comparisons, real world evidence data) for assigned BI products.
- Finally, yet importantly, you develop and maintain relevant partnerships with payers, academic research institutions, contract research organizations and other HEOR thought leaders in order to optimize the impact of HEOR & PRO research.

Additional responsibilities as Senior Manager:

- You will define long-term global development strategies for the assets, in close collaboration with the global Marketing and global Medical counterparts, to ensure optimal patient access.
- In addition, you will draft long-term publication strategies, considering the long-term global market development.

Requirements

- Graduate degree, preferably PhD in health economics, Medicine (MD), public health, pharmacy, focusing on Health Technology Assessment, PRO, Pharmacy, Medicine, Public Health
- Several years of pharma industry experience, with positions in areas of relevance for HEOR, PRO consulting or payer authorities
- Multiple years of direct experience undertaking Health Technology Assessments (HTA) & PRO including Evaluations for Regulatory and health authority interventions of pharmaceutical products
- Conducting or being part of a team working on non-interventional studies and RWE programs
- Demonstrated experience of successful regulatory, reimbursement negotiations for launching new products in key markets
- Proven track record of delivering value demonstration materials that resulted in timely patient access and adoption
- Proven ability in appraising clinical evidence (both RCTs and operational evidence)
- Profound knowledge and expertise to formulating COA strategies including validation methods, administration of measures and statistical analyses of COA data
- Excellent communication and influencing skill both in internal and external context

Additional requirements as Senior HEOR Manager:

- Long-term pharma industry experience, with positions in the areas of health economics, pricing & reimbursement, consulting, or payer authorities
- Several years of exposure to international business on a day-to-day basis
- Strong track record in value generation, demonstration and/or communication
- Highly experienced in conducting health economics/outcomes research across multiple specialty disciplines (e.g. patient reported outcomes, health economic modelling, real world data generation)

jobs.occupation: Automation Engineer - Project Execution und Product Development (all genders welcome) (Ingenieur/in - Batterietechnik)
jobs.description:
Unternehmen

thyssenkrupp nucera offers world-leading technologies for high-efficiency electrolysis plants. The company has extensive in-depth knowledge in the engineering, procurement, and construction of electrochemical plants and a strong track record of more than 600 projects with a total rating of over 10 gigawatts already successfully installed. With its water electrolysis technology to produce green hydrogen, the company offers an innovative solution on an industrial scale for green value chains and an industry fueled by clean energy – a major step towards a climate-neutrality.
www.thyssenkrupp-nucera.com

Aufgaben

You will be part of our global Automation organization and play a key role in the development, maintenance and continuous improvement of automation standards for electrolysis projects, including green hydrogen (AWE), chlor-alkali and HCl electrolysis technologies.
Your role involves assuming responsibility for defined engineering work packages to support parallel project execution and enhance delivery reliability and throughput as well as responsibility for complete automation scopes during various phases of project execution.
Your tasks:

- Acting as a technical lead for automation topics within projects executed by our global automation team
- Performing basic and detail engineering for control and safety systems, including architecture design, hardware planning and software concepts
- Supporting technical procurement, supplier clarification and evaluation of automation components and systems
- Preparing and supporting Factory Acceptance Tests, including coordination with suppliers and alignment within our global automation team
- Providing support for installation, commissioning, and troubleshooting activities for automation systems at construction sites worldwide, primarily through short-term assignments (remote and on-site, as required)
- Serving as a key technical interface within our global automation organization and other global stakeholders
- Ensuring compliance with internal standards, project-specific requirements, functional safety and IT/OT security guidelines
- Creating and reviewing technical documentation using database-based and engineering IT tools
- Actively sharing knowledge and best practices and mentoring junior engineers
- Contributing to the continuous improvement of our automation solutions
- Contribute to the development, maintenance and evolution of standardized automation solutions
- Drive modularization, reusability and productization of automation assets to support scalable and future-proof solutions

Profil

- Degree in Automation Engineering, Electrical Engineering or comparable technical discipline
- Several years of professional experience in automation engineering for industrial or process plants, preferably in chemical or electrolysis plant engineering
- Strong hands-on experience with industrial automation systems and hardware, including SAS and PLC platforms from leading manufacturers
- Strong understanding of automation system architectures
- Interest or experience in new automation technologies, digitalization, simulation or advanced engineering methods is an advantage
- Solid knowledge of network and fieldbus technologies (e.g. Profinet, Modbus TCP)
- Experience or strong understanding of functional safety and IT/OT security concepts in industrial environments
- Ability to work independently and structured, with a strong sense of ownership for technical results and quality
- Proven capability to work in international and intercultural teams
- Very good English und German communication skills, both written and verbal (min. C1)
- Willingness to travel internationally for short-term assignments
- Natural inclination to coach and support less experienced colleagues, acting as a role model within the team

Das bieten wir

As part of the thyssenkrupp group, we offer our employees high level conditions and many benefits:

- performance-related compensation according to collective agreement Metal und Electro NRW
- attractive old-age provision models
- groupwide learning measures
- thyssenkrupp Group health campaigns and programs
At thyssenkrupp nucera, we attach great importance to individual needs - to this end, we are constantly developing as an employer and offer a wide range of benefits for your perfect working-life-balance:
- In an environment characterized by flat hierarchies and a lot of personal responsibility, we create space for individual development.
- We offer further training and support in line with your individual strengths and goals in order to optimally accompany your career path.
- In intercultural and interdisciplinary teams, communication at eye level is our top priority.
- Flexitime, part-time, home office, mobile working abroad: whenever possible, we give you the flexibility you want for your work.
- For the perfect office days, we provide state-of-the-art equipment at our global locations as well as quiet and communal areas for every situation.
- For a potential move to a location near the office, we will support your relocation organizationally and financially - also internationally.
- Your personal business buddy will be at your side during your induction - so new starters quickly get to know the company, the department and their colleagues.
- If that's not enough for you: by working on green hydrogen technologies, we are ensuring clean energy for the future. Be a part of it: new era is you.

Kontakt

Thomas Worobjew
People Attraction and Acquisition Expert
nca-de-recruiting@thyssenkrupp-nucera.com

Wir wertschätzen Vielfalt

We value diversity and therefore welcome all applications, irrespective of gender, nationality, ethnic and social background, religion and beliefs, disability, age, or sexual orientation and identity.

The Friedrich Schiller University Jena is a dynamic and innovation-driven university centrally located in Germany. With a broad range of disciplines, it shapes the future through excellent research and teaching. Its scientific excellence is reflected in the profile areas Light - Life - Liberty, which provide pioneering insights and sustainable solutions for the society of tomorrow. Through close collaborations with leading research institutions, innovative companies, and renowned cultural organizations, it advances interdisciplinary developments. With around 17,000 students and approximately 10,000 employees, it defines Jena as a vibrant, internationally connected city of science and innovation.

The Institute of Biodiversity, Ecology and Evolution at the Faculty of Biological Sciences seeks to fill the position of a

Doctoral Researcher in Viral Ecology (m/f/d)

commencing on 01 December 2026. We offer a part-time position (65%, 26 hours per week), with a fixed-term employment until 30 June 2030.

The DFG-funded Collaborative Research Centre 1768 “VirusREvolution: Decoding tools for virus research” is a highly ambitious research centre at Friedrich Schiller University with the joint goal to develop novel tools for virus discovery, characterisation, regulation, interaction, and visualisation (https://virusrevolution.uni-jena.de/). Its integrated research training group is educating doctoral researchers in a structured, interdisciplinary training program and invites applications for doctoral and postdoctoral researcher positions in various fields of research.
In this doctoral project “Do viruses exploit their quasispecies for host range evolution?”, you will investigate how host range and environmental conditions shape virus diversity and virus-host interactions in natural and experimentally manipulated microbial communities.
Conduct experimental work and analyses on virus-host interactions in soil and groundwater ecosystems, including host-range assays, environmental sampling, and targeted microcosm experiments
Analyse metagenomic and viromic data sets from soil and groundwater samples to identify broad- and narrow-host-range viruses to characterize their quasispecies characteristics
Participation in the Collaborative Research Centre VirusREvolution and close collaboration with the tandem project partner
Engage in regular discussions with other group and project members
Collaborate with BSc and MSc students working in associated projects
Publish papers and present your work at national and international scientific meetings

A highly motivated candidate with a Master of Science or equivalent degree in biology, microbiology, microbial ecology, virology, bioinformatics, or a related discipline
Experience in experimental microbiology, microbial ecology, and molecular biological methods; knowledge of sequencing-based bioinformatic approaches (metagenomics, viromics); experience with virus-host interactions are desirable.
Strong analytical thinking and problem-solving
Ability to work independently and in a collaborative team
Excellent skills in English are required, both written and spoken

Embedding in a cross-disciplinary, experienced research group and a large, ambitious research consortium
Affiliation to an Integrated Research Training Group, offering close support and a comprehensive education program for hard skills and transferable skills, supported by the Jena Graduate Academy
A family-friendly working environment with a variety of offers for families
University health promotion and a wide range of university sports activities
Remuneration based on the provisions of the Collective Agreement for the Public Sector of the Federal States (TV-L) up to salary scale E13 - depending on the candidate’s personal qualifications -, including a special annual payment in accordance with the collective agreement.
30 days of vacation per calendar year plus two days off on December 24 and 31
